import type { GeospatialCamera, GeospatialLimits } from "@babylonjs/lite";

const TWO_PI = Math.PI * 2;
const GEO_EPSILON = 0.001;

const activeLimits = new WeakMap<GeospatialCamera, GeospatialLimits>();
const installed = new WeakMap<GeospatialCamera, boolean>();
const wrappedSetOrientation = new WeakSet<() => void>();

function isFiniteNumber(value: unknown): value is number { return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value); }

function getLimits(camera: GeospatialCamera): GeospatialLimits {
  return activeLimits.get(camera) ?? camera.limits;
}

function clampRadius(limits: GeospatialLimits, value: number, currentRadius: number): number {
  if (!isFiniteNumber(value)) return isFiniteNumber(currentRadius) ? currentRadius : value;
  const min = limits.radiusMin;
  const max = limits.radiusMax;
  if (!isFiniteNumber(min) || !isFiniteNumber(max)) return value;
  const lower = Math.min(min, max);
  const upper = Math.max(min, max);
  if (value < lower) return lower;
  if (value > upper) return upper;
  return value;
}

function wrapAngleToInterval(value: number, start: number): number {
  let normalized = (value - start) % TWO_PI;
  if (normalized < 0) normalized += TWO_PI;
  normalized += start;
  if (normalized >= start + TWO_PI) normalized -= TWO_PI;
  return normalized;
}

function clampYaw(limits: GeospatialLimits, value: number): number {
  if (!isFiniteNumber(value)) return value;
  const min = limits.yawMin;
  const max = limits.yawMax;
  if (!isFiniteNumber(min) || !isFiniteNumber(max)) return value;

  const span = max >= min ? max - min : TWO_PI - (min - max);
  if (span >= TWO_PI - GEO_EPSILON) {
    return wrapAngleToInterval(value, min);
  }

  const normalized = wrapAngleToInterval(value, min);
  if (max >= min) {
    if (normalized > max) return max;
    if (normalized < min) return min;
    return normalized;
  }

  const upper = max + TWO_PI;
  if (normalized > upper) return max;
  if (normalized >= TWO_PI) return normalized - TWO_PI;
  return normalized;
}

import type { GeospatialCamera, GeospatialLimits } from "@babylonjs/lite";

const TWO_PI = Math.PI * 2;
const EPSILON = 0.001;

interface EnforcementState {
  radiusInstalled: boolean;
  yawInstalled: boolean;
  limitsInstalled: boolean;
  setOrientationInstalled: boolean;
}

const states = new WeakMap<GeospatialCamera, EnforcementState>();
const activeLimits = new WeakMap<GeospatialCamera, GeospatialLimits>();
const wrappedSetOrientation = new WeakSet<object>();

function getOrCreateState(camera: GeospatialCamera): EnforcementState {
  let state = states.get(camera);
  if (!state) {
    state = { radiusInstalled: false, yawInstalled: false, limitsInstalled: false, setOrientationInstalled: false };
    states.set(camera, state);
  }
  return state;
}

function isFiniteNumber(value: unknown): value is number {
  return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value);
}

function getLimits(camera: GeospatialCamera): GeospatialLimits {
  return activeLimits.get(camera) ?? camera.limits;
}

function clampRadius(limits: GeospatialLimits, value: number, currentRadius: number): number {
  const min = limits.radiusMin;
  const max = limits.radiusMax;
  if (!isFiniteNumber(min) || !isFiniteNumber(max)) {
    return value;
  }
  const lower = Math.min(min, max);
  const upper = Math.max(min, max);
  if (!isFiniteNumber(value)) {
    if (isFiniteNumber(currentRadius)) {
      return Math.min(Math.max(currentRadius, lower), upper);
    }
    return lower;
  }
  if (value < lower) return lower;
  if (value > upper) return upper;
  return value;
}

function wrapAngleToInterval(value: number, start: number): number {
  let normalized = (value - start) % TWO_PI;
  if (normalized < 0) normalized += TWO_PI;
  normalized += start;
  if (normalized >= start + TWO_PI) normalized -= TWO_PI;
  return normalized;
}

function clampYaw(limits: GeospatialLimits, value: number): number {
  const min = limits.yawMin;
  const max = limits.yawMax;
  if (!isFiniteNumber(value) || !isFiniteNumber(min) || !isFiniteNumber(max)) {
    return value;
  }

  if (Math.abs(max - min) >= TWO_PI - EPSILON) {
    return wrapAngleToInterval(value, min);
  }

  const normalized = wrapAngleToInterval(value, min);

  if (max >= min) {
    if (normalized <= max) return normalized;
    const distToMax = normalized - max;
    const distToMin = min + TWO_PI - normalized;
    return distToMin <= distToMax ? min : max;
  }

  const upper = max + TWO_PI;
  if (normalized <= upper) {
    return normalized >= TWO_PI ? normalized - TWO_PI : normalized;
  }

  const distToMax = normalized - upper;
  const distToMin = min + TWO_PI - normalized;
  return distToMin <= distToMax ? min : max;
}

function findDescriptor(obj: object, prop: string): PropertyDescriptor | undefined {
  let target: object | null = obj;
  while (target) {
    const desc = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(target, prop);
    if (desc) return desc;
    target = Object.getPrototypeOf(target) as object | null;
  }
  return undefined;
}

function installClampedNumberProperty(camera: GeospatialCamera, prop: "radius" | "yaw"): boolean {
  const target = camera as object;
  const existing = findDescriptor(target, prop);
  const originalGet = existing && typeof existing.get === "function"
    ? (existing.get as () => number).bind(camera)
    : undefined;
  const originalSet = existing && typeof existing.set === "function"
    ? (existing.set as (value: number) => void).bind(camera)
    : undefined;

  let backing: number;
  if (originalGet) {
    backing = Number(originalGet());
  } else if (existing && "value" in existing) {
    backing = Number(existing.value);
  } else {
    backing = Number((camera as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[prop]);
  }

  const useBackingForGet = !originalGet || !originalSet;
  const isRadius = prop === "radius";

  const descriptor: PropertyDescriptor = {
    configurable: true,
    enumerable: existing?.enumerable ?? true,
    get(): number {
      return useBackingForGet ? backing : originalGet!();
    },
    set(value: number): void {
      const limits = getLimits(camera);
      const current = useBackingForGet ? backing : originalGet!();
      const clamped = isRadius ? clampRadius(limits, value, current) : clampYaw(limits, value);
      if (originalSet) originalSet(clamped);
      backing = clamped;
    },
  };

  return Reflect.defineProperty(target, prop, descriptor);
}

function installLimitsProperty(camera: GeospatialCamera): boolean {
  const target = camera as object;
  const existing = findDescriptor(target, "limits");
  const originalGet = existing && typeof existing.get === "function"
    ? (existing.get as () => GeospatialLimits).bind(camera)
    : undefined;
  const originalSet = existing && typeof existing.set === "function"
    ? (existing.set as (value: GeospatialLimits) => void).bind(camera)
    : undefined;

  let backing: GeospatialLimits;
  if (originalGet) {
    backing = originalGet();
  } else if (existing && "value" in existing) {
    backing = existing.value as GeospatialLimits;
  } else {
    backing = camera.limits;
  }

  const useBackingForGet = !originalGet || !originalSet;

  const descriptor: PropertyDescriptor = {
    configurable: true,
    enumerable: existing?.enumerable ?? true,
    get(): GeospatialLimits {
      const active = activeLimits.get(camera);
      if (active) return active;
      return useBackingForGet ? backing : originalGet!();
    },
    set(value: GeospatialLimits): void {
      activeLimits.set(camera, value);
      if (originalSet) {
        try {
          originalSet(value);
        } catch {
          // Keep the mode limits object as the camera's reported limits even if
          // the original setter rejects it.
        }
      }
      if (useBackingForGet) backing = value;
    },
  };

  return Reflect.defineProperty(target, "limits", descriptor);
}

function installSetOrientationWrapper(camera: GeospatialCamera): boolean {
  const original = camera._setOrientation;
  if (typeof original !== "function") return false;
  if (wrappedSetOrientation.has(original)) return true;

  const callable = original as unknown as (yaw: number, pitch: number, radius: number, center: unknown) => void;
  const wrapper = function (yaw: number, pitch: number, radius: number, center: unknown): void {
    const limits = getLimits(camera);
    const currentRadius = Number((camera as unknown as Record<string, unknown>).radius);
    const clampedYaw = clampYaw(limits, yaw);
    const clampedRadius = clampRadius(limits, radius, currentRadius);
    callable.call(camera, clampedYaw, pitch, clampedRadius, center);
  } as GeospatialCamera["_setOrientation"];

  wrappedSetOrientation.add(wrapper);
  const ok = Reflect.defineProperty(camera as object, "_setOrientation", {
    configurable: true,
    enumerable: true,
    writable: true,
    value: wrapper,
  });
  if (ok) return true;

  // Some implementations may expose _setOrientation as a non-configurable
  // accessor; assignment can still work if it is writable.
  const assigned = Reflect.set(camera as object, "_setOrientation", wrapper);
  if (assigned && camera._setOrientation === wrapper) return true;
  wrappedSetOrientation.delete(wrapper);
  return false;
}

export function useModeLimits(camera: GeospatialCamera, limits: GeospatialLimits): void {
  const state = getOrCreateState(camera);
  activeLimits.set(camera, limits);

  if (!state.radiusInstalled) {
    state.radiusInstalled = installClampedNumberProperty(camera, "radius");
  }
  if (!state.yawInstalled) {
    state.yawInstalled = installClampedNumberProperty(camera, "yaw");
  }
  if (!state.limitsInstalled) {
    state.limitsInstalled = installLimitsProperty(camera);
  }
  if (!state.setOrientationInstalled) {
    state.setOrientationInstalled = installSetOrientationWrapper(camera);
  }

  Reflect.set(camera as object, "limits", limits);

  const currentRadius = Number((camera as unknown as Record<string, unknown>).radius);
  Reflect.set(camera as object, "radius", clampRadius(getLimits(camera), currentRadius, currentRadius));

  const currentYaw = Number((camera as unknown as Record<string, unknown>).yaw);
  Reflect.set(camera as object, "yaw", clampYaw(getLimits(camera), currentYaw));
}
```

import type { GeospatialCamera, GeospatialLimits } from "@babylonjs/lite";

const TWO_PI = Math.PI * 2;
const EPSILON = 0.001;

interface EnforcementState {
  radiusInstalled: boolean;
  yawInstalled: boolean;
  limitsInstalled: boolean;
  setOrientationInstalled: boolean;
}

const states = new WeakMap<GeospatialCamera, EnforcementState>();
const activeLimits = new WeakMap<GeospatialCamera, GeospatialLimits>();
const wrappedSetOrientation = new WeakSet<object>();

function getOrCreateState(camera: GeospatialCamera): EnforcementState {
  let state = states.get(camera);
  if (!state) {
    state = {
      radiusInstalled: false,
      yawInstalled: false,
      limitsInstalled: false,
      setOrientationInstalled: false,
    };
    states.set(camera, state);
  }
  return state;
}

function isFiniteNumber(value: unknown): value is number {
  return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value);
}

function getLimits(camera: GeospatialCamera): GeospatialLimits {
  return activeLimits.get(camera) ?? camera.limits;
}

function clampRadius(limits: GeospatialLimits, value: number, currentRadius: number = value): number {
  const min = limits.radiusMin;
  const max = limits.radiusMax;
  if (!isFiniteNumber(min) || !isFiniteNumber(max)) {
    return value;
  }

  const lower = Math.min(min, max);
  const upper = Math.max(min, max);

  if (!isFiniteNumber(value)) {
    if (isFiniteNumber(currentRadius)) {
      return clampRadius(limits, currentRadius, currentRadius);
    }
    return lower;
  }

  if (value < lower) return lower;
  if (value > upper) return upper;
  return value;
}

function wrapAngleToInterval(value: number, start: number): number {
  let normalized = (value - start) % TWO_PI;
  if (normalized < 0) normalized += TWO_PI;
  normalized += start;
  if (normalized >= start + TWO_PI) normalized -= TWO_PI;
  return normalized;
}

function clampYaw(limits: GeospatialLimits, value: number, currentYaw: number = value): number {
  const min = limits.yawMin;
  const max = limits.yawMax;
  if (!isFiniteNumber(min) || !isFiniteNumber(max)) {
    return value;
  }

  if (!isFiniteNumber(value)) {
    if (isFiniteNumber(currentYaw)) {
      return clampYaw(limits, currentYaw, currentYaw);
    }
    return min;
  }

  if (Math.abs(max - min) >= TWO_PI - EPSILON) {
    const start = min <= max ? min : max;
    return wrapAngleToInterval(value, start);
  }

  const normalized = wrapAngleToInterval(value, min);
  if (normalized < min) normalized = min;

  if (max >= min) {
    if (normalized <= max) return normalized;
    const distToMax = normalized - max;
    const distToMin = min + TWO_PI - normalized;
    return distToMin <= distToMax ? min : max;
  }

  const upper = max + TWO_PI;
  if (normalized <= upper) {
    return normalized >= TWO_PI ? normalized - TWO_PI : normalized;
  }

  const distToMax = normalized - upper;
  const distToMin = min + TWO_PI - normalized;
  return distToMin <= distToMax ? min : max;
}

function findDescriptor(obj: object, prop: string): PropertyDescriptor | undefined {
  let target: object | null = obj;
  while (target) {
    const desc = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(target, prop);
    if (desc) return desc;
    target = Object.getPrototypeOf(target) as object | null;
  }
  return undefined;
}

function installClampedNumberProperty(camera: GeospatialCamera, prop: "radius" | "yaw"): boolean {
  const target = camera as object;
  const existing = findDescriptor(target, prop);

  const originalGet = existing && typeof existing.get === "function"
    ? (existing.get as () => number).bind(camera)
    : undefined;
  const originalSet = existing && typeof existing.set === "function"
    ? (existing.set as (value: number) => void).bind(camera)
    : undefined;

  let backing: number;
  if (originalGet) {
    backing = Number(originalGet());
  } else if (existing && "value" in existing) {
    backing = Number(existing.value);
  } else {
    backing = Number((camera as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[prop]);
  }

  let preferBacking = !originalGet || !originalSet;
  let applying = false;
  const isRadius = prop === "radius";

  const descriptor: PropertyDescriptor = {
    configurable: true,
    enumerable: existing?.enumerable ?? true,
    get(): number {
      return preferBacking ? backing : originalGet!();
    },
    set(value: number): void {
      const limits = getLimits(camera);
      const current = preferBacking ? backing : originalGet!();
      const clamped = isRadius
        ? clampRadius(limits, value, current)
        : clampYaw(limits, value, current);

      if (originalSet && !applying) {
        applying = true;
        try {

function installLimitsProperty(camera: GeospatialCamera): boolean {
  const target = camera as object;
  const existing = findDescriptor(target, "limits");

  const originalGet = existing && typeof existing.get === "function"
    ? (existing.get as () => GeospatialLimits).bind(camera)
    : undefined;
  const originalSet = existing && typeof existing.set === "function"
    ? (existing.set as (value: GeospatialLimits) => void).bind(camera)
    : undefined;

  let backing: GeospatialLimits;
  if (originalGet) {
    backing = originalGet();
  } else if (existing && "value" in existing) {
    backing = existing.value as GeospatialLimits;
  } else {
    backing = camera.limits;
  }

  let preferBacking = !originalGet || !originalSet;
  let applying = false;

  const descriptor: PropertyDescriptor = {
    configurable: true,
    enumerable: existing?.enumerable ?? true,
    get(): GeospatialLimits {
      const active = activeLimits.get(camera);
      if (active) return active;
      return preferBacking ? backing : originalGet!();
    },
    set(value: GeospatialLimits): void {
      activeLimits.set(camera, value);

      if (originalSet && !applying) {
        applying = true;
        try {
          originalSet(value);
        } catch {
          preferBacking = true;
        } finally {
          applying = false;
        }
      }

      if (preferBacking) backing = value;
    },
  };

  return Reflect.defineProperty(target, "limits", descriptor);
}

function installSetOrientationWrapper(camera: GeospatialCamera): boolean {
  const original = camera._setOrientation;
  if (typeof original !== "function") return false;
  if (wrappedSetOrientation.has(original)) return true;

  const callable = original as unknown as (yaw: number, pitch: number, radius: number, center: unknown) => void;
  const wrapper = function (yaw: number, pitch: number, radius: number, center: unknown): void {
    const limits = getLimits(camera);
    const currentRadius = Number((camera as unknown as Record<string, unknown>).radius);
    const currentYaw = Number((camera as unknown as Record<string, unknown>).yaw);
    const clampedYaw = clampYaw(limits, yaw, currentYaw);
    const clampedRadius = clampRadius(limits, radius, currentRadius);
    callable.call(camera, clampedYaw, pitch, clampedRadius, center);
  } as GeospatialCamera["_setOrientation"];

  wrappedSetOrientation.add(wrapper);

  const ok = Reflect.defineProperty(camera as object, "_setOrientation", {
    configurable: true,
    enumerable: true,
    writable: true,
    value: wrapper,
  });
  if (ok) return true;

  const assigned = Reflect.set(camera as object, "_setOrientation", wrapper);
  if (assigned && camera._setOrientation === wrapper) return true;

  wrappedSetOrientation.delete(wrapper);
  return false;
}

export function useModeLimits(camera: GeospatialCamera, limits: GeospatialLimits): void {
  if (!camera || !limits) return;

  const state = getOrCreateState(camera);
  activeLimits.set(camera, limits);

  if (!state.radiusInstalled) {
    state.radiusInstalled = installClampedNumberProperty(camera, "radius");
  }
  if (!state.yawInstalled) {
    state.yawInstalled = installClampedNumberProperty(camera, "yaw");
  }
  if (!state.limitsInstalled) {
    state.limitsInstalled = installLimitsProperty(camera);
  }
  if (!state.setOrientationInstalled) {
    state.setOrientationInstalled = installSetOrientationWrapper(camera);
  }

  const currentRadius = Number((camera as unknown as Record<string, unknown>).radius);
  Reflect.set(camera as object, "radius", clampRadius(getLimits(camera), currentRadius, currentRadius));

  const currentYaw = Number((camera as unknown as Record<string, unknown>).yaw);
  Reflect.set(camera as object, "yaw", clampYaw(getLimits(camera), currentYaw, currentYaw));
}

function installSetOrientationWrapper(camera: GeospatialCamera): boolean {
  let original: unknown;
  try {
    original = camera._setOrientation;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
  if (typeof original !== "function") return false;
  if (wrappedSetOrientation.has(original as object)) return true;

  const callable = original as unknown as (yaw: number, pitch: number, radius: number, center: unknown) => void;
  const wrapper = function (yaw: number, pitch: number, radius: number, center: unknown): void {
    const limits = getLimits(camera);
    const currentRadius = safeNumber(camera as object, "radius");
    const currentYaw = safeNumber(camera as object, "yaw");
    const clampedYaw = clampYaw(limits, yaw, currentYaw);
    const clampedRadius = clampRadius(limits, radius, currentRadius);
    try {
      callable.call(camera, clampedYaw, pitch, clampedRadius, center);
    } catch {
      Reflect.set(camera as object, "radius", clampedRadius);
      Reflect.set(camera as object, "yaw", clampedYaw);
    }
  } as GeospatialCamera["_setOrientation"];

  wrappedSetOrientation.add(wrapper);
  const ok = Reflect.defineProperty(camera as object, "_setOrientation", { ... });
  if (ok) return true;
  const assigned = Reflect.set(camera as object, "_setOrientation", wrapper);
  let installedBySet = false;
  try { installedBySet = assigned && camera._setOrientation === wrapper; } catch { installedBySet = false; }
  if (installedBySet) return true;
  wrappedSetOrientation.delete(wrapper);
  return false;
}
```
